messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance — Sat 22 Feb, 20:00–23:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The firm's document management system will be unavailable on Saturday 22 February between 20:00 and 23:00 GMT for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please save and close all documents before 20:00. Email and the data rooms are unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
